newsitem.title: USA: RSR restarts lead smelter after 3-week shutdown.
newsitem.headline: RSR restarts lead smelter after 3-week shutdown.

text.p: RSR Corp is bringing its Indianapolis lead smelter back from a three-week shutdown, the company's president told Reuters, and is planning a two-week shutdown of its Los Angeles smelter "within a couple of months."

Originally slated for a two-week shutdown in the last two weeks of July, the 114,000-tonne-a-year secondary smelter stayed down for an extra week "to perform some additional maintanence," said Bob Finn, RSR's president.
The Los Angeles smelter has a capacity of 96,000 tonnes a year.
The shutdowns coincide with the onset of the heavy battery production period. Many dealers say that the lead market has tightened in the last several weeks.
((--Derek J. Caney, New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1646))
